summary: omit placeholders no longer carry over from loop items into task templating; values that resolve to omit are dropped from loop items, so use `| default(omit)` in the task.
questions: Why does omit in my loop items no longer omit the task parameter?
How do I omit a module option based on a loop item in ansible-core 2.19?

answer_card.title: omit no longer leaks from loop items
answer_card.answer_md:
Previously an `omit` placeholder could stay embedded in a loop item and later act as an `omit` for task arguments. Now values resolving to `omit` are **dropped immediately** when loop items are templated.

To turn a missing value into an omit for the task, use `| default(omit)` on the task argument. This works on older ansible-core versions too.
